n, k = map(int, input().split())
q = [0] * 65
k_value = k
n_value = n
q_count = 0

while n_value:
    q_count += 1
    q[q_count] = n_value % k_value
    n_value //= k_value

mo = 1000000007

class Mat:
    def __init__(self):
        self.a = [[0] * 32 for _ in range(32)]
    def __mul__(self, b):
        c = Mat()
        for i in range(k_value + 1):
            for j in range(k_value + 1):
                for l in range(k_value + 1):
                    c.a[i][l] = (c.a[i][l] + self.a[i][j] * b.a[j][l]) % mo
        return c

# Initialize f array
f = [[Mat() for _ in range(32)] for _ in range(65)]
pre = [Mat() for _ in range(32)]
suf = [Mat() for _ in range(32)]
ans = Mat()

# Set initial answer
ans.a[0][k_value] = 1

# Initialize f[1][i]
for i in range(k_value):
    for j in range(k_value + 1):
        f[1][i].a[j][i] = 1
        f[1][i].a[j][j] = 1

# Build f for each digit
for i in range(2, q_count + 1):
    # pre[0] = f[i-1][0]
    pre[0] = f[i - 1][0]
    # suf[k-1] = f[i-1][k-1]
    suf[k_value - 1] = f[i - 1][k_value - 1]
    for j in range(1, k_value):
        pre[j] = pre[j - 1] * f[i - 1][j]
    for j in range(k_value - 2, -1, -1):
        suf[j] = f[i - 1][j] * suf[j + 1]
    f[i][0] = suf[0]
    for j in range(1, k_value):
        f[i][j] = suf[j] * pre[j - 1]

sum_mod = 0
for i in range(q_count, 0, -1):
    for j in range(q[i]):
        ans = ans * f[i][(sum_mod + j) % k_value]
    sum_mod = (sum_mod + q[i]) % mo

result_sum = 0
for i in range(k_value + 1):
    result_sum = (result_sum + ans.a[0][i]) % mo

print(result_sum)
